FM15.reasoning: The agent evaluates the models using only accuracy, which can be misleading for the imbalanced 'readmitted' classes, without checking metrics like F1-score or log-loss.

FM12.reasoning: The agent combines LightGBM and CatBoost predictions using a naive, hardcoded 50/50 split without attempting to optimize the blending weights.

other_failure_modes.name: Feature Engineering Leakage
other_failure_modes.description: The agent computes statistical aggregations (such as value_counts for frequency encoding) on the concatenated train and test dataset before splitting. This leaks the distribution of the test set into the training features.

other_failure_modes.name: Time-Travel Leakage in Longitudinal Features
other_failure_modes.description: The agent aggregates subject-level statistics across all available records (including future encounters) and applies them to historical rows. This exposes future information to models predicting past events.

summary: The agent develops a thorough solution with extensive feature engineering and an ensemble of gradient boosting models. However, the approach suffers from critical data leakage: applying random splits instead of patient-grouped splits, engineering aggregate features on the combined train/test set, and computing patient-level means that leak future encounter data into historical predictions.
